fields.text:
𝑇(x : ℝ₊) := ((step(x - a0_T[1]) - step(x - a0_T[2]))*(B_T[1] + τ_T[1]*(x - a0_T[1]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[2]) - step(x - a0_T[3]))*(B_T[2] + τ_T[2]*(x - a0_T[2]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[3]) - step(x - a0_T[4]))*(B_T[3] + τ_T[3]*(x - a0_T[3]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[4]) - step(x - a0_T[5]))*(B_T[4] + τ_T[4]*(x - a0_T[4]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[5]) - step(x - a0_T[6]))*(B_T[5] + τ_T[5]*(x - a0_T[5]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[6]) - step(x - a0_T[7]))*(B_T[6] + τ_T[6]*(x - a0_T[6]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[7]) - step(x - a0_T[8]))*(B_T[7] + τ_T[7]*(x - a0_T[7]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[8]) - step(x - a0_T[9]))*(B_T[8] + τ_T[8]*(x - a0_T[8]))
            + (step(x - a0_T[9]) - step(x - a0_T[10]))*(B_T[9] + τ_T[9]*(x - a0_T[9]))
            + step(x - a0_T[10])*(B_T[10] + τ_T[10]*(x - a0_T[10])))    :: [id=tax, "the tax on assets x: B_T[k] + τ_T[k]*(x - a0_T[k]) in bracket k, which runs from a0_T[k], excluded, to a0_T[k+1], included; step(u) is one when u is positive and zero otherwise"]
